gates.name: changelog_unreleased
gates.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const t=fs.readFileSync('CHANGELOG.md','utf8');const needle='Antigravity empty-response errors now name the denied tools';const uStart=t.indexOf('## [Unreleased]');const vStart=t.indexOf('## [7.5.1]');if(uStart<0||vStart<0||uStart>vStart)process.exit(1);const u=t.slice(uStart,vStart);if(!u.includes('### Fixed')||!u.includes(needle))process.exit(1);const after=t.slice(vStart+10);const next=after.indexOf('## [');const v751=next<0?after:after.slice(0,next);if(v751.includes(needle))process.exit(1);"

gates.name: full_verification
gates.cmd: npm run build && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint src/ bin/ && npm run format:check && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run
